observations: Three photos show the same solar panel from slightly different angles.
The panel has a white frame and dark blue/black photovoltaic cells arranged in a grid.
Cells are rectangular with rounded corners, connected by thin white lines (busbars).
No brand or model name is visible on the front of the panel in any photo.
A watermark 'MIMI SOLAR POSTED ON JUJU' is overlaid on all photos.
The panel is leaning against a wall or structure outdoors, with concrete ground and some tools or materials nearby.
No backside, junction box, or label is visible in any photo.

claims.claim: Mimi solar investment do in all kind of solar energy, solar panels, inverter, solar chest...
claims.evidence: The seller's text claims to sell various solar products, but the photos show only one solar panel. No inverters or solar chests are visible. The claim about 'all kind of solar energy' cannot be verified from the photos alone.

risks.risk: The solar panel may be damaged, defective, or non-functional (e.g., broken cells, poor connections, or degraded performance).
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the backside showing the junction box, wiring, and any damage or corrosion, plus a photo of the panel under sunlight with a multimeter reading voltage and current.

risks.risk: The panel may be counterfeit or low-quality with no warranty or certification.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the label or nameplate on the backside showing brand, model, power rating, efficiency, and certification marks (e.g., IEC, CE).

risks.risk: The panel may have been previously used or salvaged, affecting its lifespan and output.
risks.proof: A photo of the backside showing any signs of wear, scratches, or previous mounting hardware, and a video of the panel being tested under sunlight.
risks.if_unproven: priced as used or unknown condition

proof_requests: Photo of the backside of the solar panel showing the junction box and label with brand, model, and specifications.
Photo or video of the panel being tested under sunlight with a multimeter to verify output.
Photo of any warranty or certification documents, if available.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a solar panel, but no brand or model is visible. Key risks such as functionality, quality, and condition cannot be assessed without additional proof. The seller's claims about other products are unverifiable from the photos. A worst-case price cannot be assigned without proof of performance and origin.
